content.description: Front view of clutch hub showing internal shifting key mechanism

content.text: 16. INSERT NO. 3 CLUTCH HUB INTO HUB SLEEVE

items: (a) Install No. 3 clutch hub and the shifting keys to the hub sleeve.
(b) Install the shifting key springs under the shifting keys.

content.text: Install the key springs positioned so that their end gaps are not in line.

content.description: Cross-section view showing SST tool positioned above hub assembly for installing shifting key retainer

content.text: (c) Using SST, install the shifting key retainer.

content.description: Illustration showing SST tool being used to drive in No. 3 clutch hub into countershaft assembly

content.text: Using SST, drive in No. 3 clutch hub.
When installing the clutch hub, support the countershaft in front with a 3.5 lb hammer or equivalent.

content.description: Hands installing snap ring onto shaft with measurement marks indicated

content.text: Select a snap ring that will allow minimum axial play and install it on the shaft.

content.description: Hands assembling spacer, synchronizer ring, needle roller bearing and counter fifth gear onto shaft

content.text: 19. INSTALL SPACER, SYNCHRONIZER RING, NEEDLE ROLLER BEARING AND COUNTER FIFTH GEAR

items: (b) Apply gear oil to the needle roller bearings.
(c) Assemble the counter 5th gear, synchronizer ring and needle roller bearings.
